message: The other night, we had a little scare when the smoke alarm went off while I was making dinner. My phone buzzed non-stop with the family group chat lighting up: "Is everything okay?" and "Did you burn the toast again?" 😂 It reminded me how important it is to have a fire escape plan, not just for the serious stuff, but for keeping the laughs going, too. A little preparation can turn a panic into a family memory!
